Grown-ups

Sound
Brushing time

The time is split into four equal parts: top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left. A chime and an arrow show when to move on. Children pick a soundtrack (pop, disco, unicorn gallop or island) with the round music buttons on the start screen; tapping one plays a short preview. They choose a unicorn with the arrows (🎨 or tapping it changes its colour); it walks along the rainbow at the bottom while they brush. Stickers are saved on this device only. The screen is kept awake while brushing where the browser allows it.
